description: This file defines a class ADODB2_mssqlnative that extends ADODB_DataDict to manage SQL Server specific data dictionary operations, including type mapping, SQL generation for schema changes, and handling of constraints within a PHP database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB2_mssqlnative
classes.description: A class providing SQL Server native data dictionary functionalities, including type mapping, schema modification SQL generation, and constraint management.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps database type identifiers to generic data types.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual SQL data type corresponding to the given meta type.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for adding columns to a table.

methods.name: defaultConstraintName
methods.description: Retrieves the default constraint name for a specified column.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter columns in a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Assembles suffix string for column definition SQL based on attributes.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating or dropping indexes.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the size and type of SQL Server data types.
